description: This record holds the version of the Global Change Analysis Model (GCAM) and the building stock model used by Siddarth Durga and colleagues to evaluate the economy-wide global impact of energy efficiency policies in buildings, with the scenario outputs. It was published on Zenodo on 5 May 2025 by Siddarth Durga, Molly French, Ellie Lochner and Meredydd Evans of the Joint Global Change Research Institute. It contains the GCAM code and analysis scripts (about 7 GB), scenario configuration files, a building stock model archive and a scenario output archive of about 21 MB. Coverage: global, by GCAM region. Access: four archives on Zenodo. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: the record's description is brief; the policies modelled, regions and years are in the associated paper and files, not in the metadata read. Simulation uses: long-term building energy demand and policy scenarios in integrated assessment. Related records: Scout and the rooftop area SSP projections.
